highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 combines Skia m150 with new image-filter tools and faster CPU blurs.
highlights_body: Adds paint bounds for quick-reject culling and overdraw visualization. Upgrading also requires replacing remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs; the deprecated notebook integration no longer ships.

breaking.title: Replace remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs
breaking.body: Remaining pre-v4 obsoletes now fail compilation. Use GRBackendRenderTarget constructors without sampleCount, text-run Glyphs/Positions properties, SKFontHinting, and SKSamplingOptions. SKPaintHinting and SKFilterQuality remain in the implementation for ABI compatibility but are absent from the reference assembly. The two SKCanvas.DrawText overloads with SKFont/SKPaint but no explicit SKTextAlign remain warning-only.

breaking.title: Notebook integration no longer ships
breaking.body: The SkiaSharp package no longer embeds its deprecated .NET Interactive / Polyglot Notebooks extension. Notebook consumers must replace that integration; this release supplies no replacement notebook extension.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled engine from m148 to m150 while preserving Tizen PDF support and the existing Windows runtime floor.
Updates bundled text shaping with AAT and Arabic fallback fixes, COLR v1 corrections, and glyph extents that cover the glyph.

SKImageFilter.CreateCrop restricts filter output with a selectable tile mode; CreateEmpty supplies a transparent-black node that discards its input. SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw maps draw counts to a six-color visualization palette.
SKPaint.GetFastBounds returns bounds including supported effects and stroke inflation for quick-reject culling. A false result means fast bounds are unavailable.
Restores the dedicated raster blur path for small-sigma 8888 images, avoiding the slower shader-based Gaussian path.
Fixes a race between opening and reusing a CoreText-backed typeface stream.
SKSurface.Canvas reuses its managed wrapper instead of repeating native lookups and registration on each access.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Completed the v4 deprecation pass, cached surface canvas wrappers, and restored the faster small-sigma raster blur path.

preview_summaries.v4.150.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduced the Skia m150 engine update while retaining Tizen PDF support and the existing Windows runtime floor.
preview_summaries.v4.150.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 updated bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1, completed the pre-v4 deprecation pass, and retired the notebook integration.
preview_summaries.v4.150.0-rc.1.1: Release Candidate 1 added crop, empty, overdraw, and paint-bounds APIs. It also improved CPU blur and canvas access performance and fixed an Apple typeface stream race.

harfbuzz_summary: No HarfBuzz binding or shaping changes accompany the test-infrastructure update.

v4.150.0-preview.1.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m150 engine.

v4.150.0-preview.2.1.headline: Preview 2 updates HarfBuzz to 14.2.1 and completes the pre-v4 deprecation pass.

v4.150.0-rc.1.1.headline: Release Candidate 1 adds filter and paint-bounds APIs alongside faster CPU blurs.

v4.150.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 is the stable shipment of the previously previewed release line.
